Episode 253: Gathering Once Again in Lafrarosa (3)
Jin and his group entered the Battle God Temple.

Vahn was sitting cross-legged in the center of the main hall of the Temple, with her eyes closed. Of course, she had already noticed Jin and his group's arrival as soon as the flagship Sarah appeared in the skies above Lafrarosa.
"You brought Bliget, brother Jin.”
"Yes, I thought he might help in finding Beltian. Has there been any progress?”

“No, none at all. This Battle God Temple is the place I have spent the most time in my life. And yet, I have never once felt the presence of something like an ego of the Sun God, so it seems that this fellow has a talent for hiding, much like Yona.”
Vahn opened her eyes and glanced at Bliget. Bliget seemed uncomfortable under her gaze.
[Hmph, I came to help, so don't stare at me like that...]
“Then find him at once. I am getting severely irritated because of that thing called Beltian.”
Vahn's anger was understandable. A monster like that had been lurking in her and her brothers' home, and she hadn’t noticed until now.
[...You don't need to be so frustrated by the fact that you couldn't find us, Vahn. It's impossible for even a Genesis Knight to find one of us who has stopped our existence.]
“Stopped your existence?”
[Yes. To put it in terms you can easily understand, it is like an animal's hibernation. We create a small subspace, enter it, and rest. Either to wait for the right time, or to forget the pain.]
Forget the pain.
Just as Bligiet could not endure the 'longing for the original form,' every ego of the Sun God had its own domain of suffering.

[In Beltian's case, he was probably suffering from the fact that the world's destruction was being delayed, because Malugia, she, had been silent for too long. In any case, I will begin now, so prepare for battle. The moment Beltian awakens, the fight will begin immediately.]
“How much time will it take?”
[It’ll be over in 5 minutes.]
Jin immediately gave orders to the entire fleet via communicator. The Golden Fleets moved swiftly, surrounding the skies.
It looked as if they were attacking Lafrarosa. In a way, that was correct. If a battle were to unfold with a being on the level of an ego of the Sun God, this place was bound to be ravaged again.
It was a sorrowful moment for the Plutonians. They had finally come out into the world and were just beginning to rebuild their city, yet Lafrarosa was once again facing a destiny of destruction.
“I feel sorry for Leuth. He was decorating our home so wonderfully.”
On the surface, Bliget didn’t seem to be doing anything particularly special. He was just standing quietly.
But the Genesis Knights could perceive him emitting some kind of invisible energy, much like how dragons call out to other dragons in a language humans cannot hear.
Creeeek...
Suddenly, the main hall of the Battle God Temple began to shake.

It wasn't just the ground and the building shaking. The party standing near Bligiet soon faced the unfamiliar sight of the entire surrounding space shimmering, and they felt their vision turn yellow. It was because sun energy was pouring into every place their eyes could reach.
Beltian was waking up.
“Faster than I thought. Let's see what kind of face this bastard has.”
Even though an ego of Destruction was awakening, no one was afraid. They only predicted that he too would soon end up in the same state as Bligiet.
Even Bliget himself had that feeling.
'If it were Malugia, I wouldn't be so sure, but Beltian... and a Beltian who has been in a state of stopped existence until just now, at that. He cannot handle the mortals here.'
Just as animals are vulnerable when they wake up from hibernation, Veltian couldn’t exert his full power at this moment.
'Be it me or Beltian, our situations are pathetic.'
Gradually, the vibrations subsided. Instead, the sun energy that had now colored the entirety of Lafrarosa began to emit an even brighter light, and from somewhere, a voice began to echo.
[Bl... Bliget... You... woke me up...]
[Beltian.]
[It seems... something has gone wrong... Huh? You, why are you in a restrained state!]
[I, like you, woke up in a weakened state, so I couldn’t face these mortals. Try winning against them yourself.]
[You foolish bastard!]
Boom!
Suddenly, a massive explosion erupted inside the main hall. Just like Kelliark's spatial explosion, it had no precursor.
However, the Genesis Knights showed monstrous strength, putting up shields almost simultaneously and even protecting the restrained Bliggiet.
“You did well without trying any tricks. We'll consider the interview canceled.”
[Thanks...]
“Luci, you return to the ship with Bliggiet. It would be best if only I, Vahn, and the kid handle the close-quarters combat.”
"Murakan is right. The brothers should form a formation on the ship."
Clunk—! Crackle!
The pillars supporting the main hall's ceiling were collapsing. The hearts of the Plutonians who watched this as they headed for their ships seemed to crumble as well.
Vahn had veins bulging from her forehead.
“Don't even think you can live unscathed after turning the main hall into this state, Beltian...”
Creak...
The ceiling was splitting apart. As chunks of steel and stone poured down to the floor, Beltian's true form, which had been hidden by the ceiling, was revealed.
A colossal eyeball, with thousands of arms grotesquely sprouting from all over it.
All those arms were holding spears. Beltian looked down at the collapsed ceiling as if peering into a burrow.
[What a nasty-looking thing you are.]
[...Strange. Are you the ones who did that to Bluggiet? But you shouldn't have been able to attack Bluggiet? And I, too, hmph!]

Vahn had already leaped and was piercing the center of Beltian's true form, the eyeball. Although it had put up a shield just like Bligiet did, this was no longer Vahn's first time facing an ego of the Sun God.

She started the fight anticipating the shield, so her sword was that much heavier and fiercer. The blade, imbued with lightning, instantly tore through the layered shields and dug deep into the eyeball.
Woosh, screech—!
[Graaaaaah...!]
Jin and Murakan had also jumped up at almost the same time as Vahn. Jin unfolded the Eternal Flame to bind Beltian's arms, and Murakan used his Black Chains to block the eyeball's path of retreat.
And as soon as the three of them stood atop the main hall, they knew. They knew that Beltian's body was not just this colossal eyeball, but was formed throughout the entirety of Lafrarosa.
The glowing sun energy, rippling like smoke, covered all of Lafrarosa. That energy was the true body of Beltian.
The allies in the fleet who were watching this from afar had already understood this. The entire fleet had already locked on and was just waiting for Vahn’s signal.
“Fire. The land can be tilled again, and the buildings can be raised again. Finishing this thing off even one minute faster is more beneficial for the world.”
Just like when they attacked the Tower of Stories, the bombardment of the Golden Fleet and VaHn’s sword resonated together.

The Eternal Flame also linked with the flagship Sarah and instantly poured blue flames across the entire sky. With Murakan's Advent of Darkness added to that, Beltian's golden energy was overshadowed by darkness.
The ego of Destruction, Beltian, was greatly disoriented as soon as he awoke.
'Bluggiet, who woke me, has his authority bound, and these mortals, what in the world.'
From the torn eyeball, sun energy was flowing out like thick blood. Although Vahn had only pierced the eyeball, sun energy poured out from Beltian's entire vast body.
'This is dangerous.'
For Beltian, it was a crisis he had never once experienced before. And the Vamel Alliance had no intention of showing him any mercy.
[You all should be erased along with the world!]
Beltian roared as he detonated his sun energy.
But there was no way it could be a threat. It would have been the same even if it were a Beltian wielding his full authority, not in a weakened state like now.
[Looks like you don't grasp the situation. Unfortunately for you, there's no escape route. Still, you have two choices: be annihilated, or become the power source for our fleet.]
[How dare you speak such nonsense, lizard.]
[Ah, but it's not like you get to choose. We've already chosen the latter.]

Murakan, who had rushed in leading the Advent of Darkness, raked his front paw across Beltian's eyeball. The eyeball was already in a state where its original form could no longer be seen, even before he clawed it.
Jin and Vahn had been circling the eye, swinging their swords faster than Beltian’s ability to regenerate, carving new wounds into the giant.
For the members of the coalition watching the Genesis Knights and Beltian from the fleet, it was impossible to think of that scene as a 'battle.'

It was too one-sided. The thousands of arms attached to the eyeball were often cut off before they could even throw the spears they held, and the body that had covered the entire sky was now so obscured by the Plutonian Domination Sword, the bombardment, and the Eternal Flame that it was difficult to even see with the naked eye.
Only the colossal eyeball was barely emitting light, while being ceaselessly torn and ripped by two swords and Murakan's claws.
From the start, they overwhelmed him and completely took control.

However, the coalition did not let its guard down. To prepare for a potential self-destruction or explosion, they did not recklessly tighten the encirclement, and after deploying dense shields, they were even ready to perform short-distance spatial jumps at any moment.
In other words, there were no variables. It seemed impossible for Beltian to turn the situation around on his own.
"...They are handling him much more easily than they did Bligiet. The only thing Beltian can hope for are enemies who will create a variable for him, I suppose."
Ameris said as she watched the battle from beyond the bridge of the flagship Sarah.
The Zipples, and the Ganestos. They would surely sense that Beltian had awoken and would come for him.
However, the Tower of Tales had suffered a major defeat to the coalition just a few days ago and was focused on escaping, and the leader of the Ganestos had recklessly used her power.
“From what this one can see, it would be best for Beltian to abandon his hopes and accept reality. Wouldn't you agree, Bligiet?”
Bliget could only nod, utterly dejected.
